features.title: One Effect service that runs the git CLI
features.summary: Run git non-interactively with bounded stdout and stderr, a timeout that kills the process and one git <verb> span; return a non-zero exit as a value or fail with redacted arguments and stderr.
failureModes: git that cannot start fails with GitRunFailed spawn-failed and a hint to install it.
A run over its timeout is stopped and its process killed.
A non-zero exit through exec carries flag-value-redacted arguments and credential-redacted stderr.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv git CLI through the Effect ChildProcessSpawner with stdin ignored, a non-interactive environment, bounded output and a timeout.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories per test, and a sleeping stand-in executable for the timeout; no git mock is used.

verification.testName: records one git <verb> client span with value-free attributes and the exit code
stops a run that exceeds its timeout
keeps flag values and credentials out of errors

telemetry.testName: records one git <verb> client span with value-free attributes and the exit code
